name: Himemiya Mai
source:
A first-year student at the academy. The only female member of the Anime Club.

The princess of the otaku club. She looks cute, but inside she's a fujoshi (a female fan of boys' love manga/anime).

She always has the boys of the Anime Club following her around.

She used to have a boyfriend in real life and has had sex.

However, she keeps that a secret.

"My boyfriend is all the club members!" is what she says.

[From [url=http://gyutto.com/i/item152444?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
